text: dsh-git-graph 是面向 DSH Web 的只读 Git 图谱插件，在原生右侧栏展示当前工作区的提交历史、分支、标签和 HEAD。它同时注册 git_graph 工具，让对话可以查询仓库状态、筛选分支并搜索提交。用户可查看提交详情、文件变更、未提交修改、两次提交之间的差异，以及历史版本的完整文本；界面支持中英文、明暗主题和按仓库保存的显示设置。适合需要在 DSH 中浏览和比较 Git 历史的开发者。运行需要 DSH Web 和 Host 上的 Git；头像显示可请求 GitHub、Gravatar 或仓库 Git 服务。

dsh-git-graph is a read-only Git viewer for DSH Web. Its sidebar shows commits, branches, tags, and file changes. The git_graph tool answers repository queries. Compare commits and inspect historical files. Requires Git on the DSH Host; avatar lookup may contact GitHub or Gravatar.
想在 DSH 侧栏里查看当前项目的 Git 提交图谱
帮我按分支浏览提交历史，但不要切换工作区分支
我想搜索提交信息、作者或哈希
怎么比较两个提交之间改了哪些文件
能不能查看某个历史版本的文件全文和差异
想直接在对话里查询仓库分支和工作区状态
Show me the commit graph and branches for my current workspace.
I need to compare files changed between two Git commits.
**dsh-git-graph** 的功能「提交历史和分支浏览」：在 DSH Web 右侧栏查看提交拓扑、HEAD、分支和标签，可按分支筛选并搜索提交。（触发入口见 src/client/index.ts:21）。
**dsh-git-graph** 的功能「提交差异与历史文件」：选择提交或文件查看详情和文件差异，也可比较两个提交、检查未提交修改，并打开历史文件的完整文本。（触发入口见 src/client/index.ts:38）。
**dsh-git-graph** 的功能「对话中的 Git 查询工具」：调用 git_graph 查询仓库提交、引用和工作区状态，可指定路径、提交数量、分支筛选、搜索词与排序方式。（触发入口见 src/runtime.ts:102）。
dsh-git-graph 使用作者头像时会请求 GitHub、Gravatar 或仓库自身 Git 服务；可在显示设置中关闭头像。

dsh-git-graph README · What's new in 0.6.1：- Update the DSH runtime and peer dependencies to **0.2.1-rc.5** and Cordis to **4.0.5**. This release targets that runtime. Restart DSH after updating.

dsh-git-graph README · What's new in 0.6.0：- Select a local or remote branch to focus its history and locate its tip, without checking it out. Branches, filters, and settings open from the top bar as dropdowns.
- Keep graph nodes aligned while commit details, file diffs, and uncommitted changes expand or collapse. Cancel obsolete reads when switching or closing views; load tag/stash metadata only when opened.
- Show when search stops at its 2,000-commit budget, preserve comma-containing references, use native Git branch patterns, and include file type changes. Root and subdirectory sessions share repository settings.
dsh-git-graph README · What's new in 0.6.0：See the [0.6.0 release notes](CHANGELOG.md#060--2026-10-22) for fixes and upgrade details.

dsh-git-graph README · Features：- **History** — Commit topology, branches, tags, HEAD, search, and history filters.
- **Branch navigation** — Search local/remote branches in the branch dropdown, focus one branch, and locate its latest commit without changing the working tree.
- **Commit details** — Inline details with author/committer dates, parents, references, signature status, and copying.
- **References** — Every reference on a commit is shown; matching local/remote labels combine, chips wrap onto another line, and the row height follows. Two alternative layouts remain.
- **File changes** — File tree/list views, per-file diffs, and uncommitted changes; select two commits and open each changed file's diff.
- **Historical source** — Read and copy the complete text of an old or new file version, with its path, commit hash, line numbers, and size.
- **Messages & authors** — Commit messages with links, bold, italic, and inline code; real author avatars from GitHub, Gravatar, and the repository's own Git service (Gitea/Gogs).
- **Display settings** — Resizable columns, date display options, compact rows, line styles, and colour presets, saved per repository.
- **Interface** — Chinese

dsh-git-graph README · Install or update：Requires DSH **0.2.1-rc.5**, the `dsh` CLI, pnpm for plugin installation, and Git installed on the DSH Host.

dsh-git-graph README · Install or update：Install the prebuilt `v0.6.1` Release package through either DSH's plugin page or the CLI. Both accept the same package source. See the official [plugin manager guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2/packages/client/ui-plugin-manager/README.md) and [packaging guide](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/dsh-v0.2.0-rc.2/docs/user/develop/basic/publish.md).

dsh-git-graph README · Install or update：In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin**, paste this URL, install it, and choose **Enable now**:

```text
https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph/releases/download/v0.6.1/dsh-git-graph-0.6.1.tgz
```

Or install from the terminal:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph/releases/download/v0.6.1/dsh-git-graph-0.6.1.tgz
```
dsh-git-graph README · Install or update：The archive includes the built `lib/` entry points. You do not need to clone this repository, build it locally, or keep a development folder at a fixed path.

dsh-git-graph README · Install or update：This `.tgz` is built with `pnpm pack` and uploaded as a GitHub Release asset; it is separate from GitHub's automatically generated source archives. DSH supports installing this package URL in both the UI and CLI. Publishing a release does not automatically list the plugin in a marketplace; installing by package name alone requires an npm publication.

dsh-git-graph README · Install or update：> **Name note.** The npm package named `dsh-git-graph` is a **different, unrelated plugin** (author `enoughpower`, version 0.1.x, with staging and commit features). This project is installed from the Release archive above; `dsh-git-graph` is used here only as the DSH bundle row id and the package name inside this repository.

Check that `dsh-git-graph` is installed at version `0.6.1`:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web list dsh-git-graph
```

dsh-git-graph README · Install or update：Start DSH Web with `dsh web`, or restart your existing instance to load the plugin. For updates, run `add` with the desired release tag, then restart that instance. Use the same profile name for installation, startup, and removal.

For 0.6.0, restart after updating so the Host and Client use the same strict data contract. Settings previously saved separately for a subdirectory are not migrated to the worktree-root settings.
dsh-git-graph README · Install or update：For a custom profile, local `.tgz` installation, or source builds, see the [development guide](docs/DEVELOPMENT.md#本地安装与自定义-profile).

dsh-git-graph README · Usage：1. Select a workspace in DSH Web and open the right sidebar.
2. Select **dsh-git-graph** from the sidebar's start page.
3. Select a commit for inline details, or a file for its diff. Select **Uncommitted Changes** to inspect working-tree changes.
4. Choose **Compare commit…** and a base commit, then select a changed file. In a historical file viewer, switch between **Diff** and **Full source**, and choose the old or new version.

dsh-git-graph README · Usage：Use **Settings** to adjust the display. Settings are saved separately for each repository.

Real avatars are enabled by default and access external avatar services: GitHub repositories search public commits by author email; other repositories ask their own Git service first (Gitea/Gogs `/avatar` endpoint) and then Gravatar; GitHub noreply addresses resolve directly. You can disable them in Settings; missing images or failed requests retain initials.

dsh-git-graph README · Uninstall：```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-git-graph
```

Use the profile you installed into, and restart it after removal.

dsh-git-graph README · Keyboard controls：| Control | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `Ctrl/Cmd+F` | Find within loaded results |
| `Ctrl/Cmd+Shift+F` | Toggle display settings |
| `Esc` | Close the branch, filter, or settings dropdown first, then Find |
| `↑` / `↓` | Select a commit when Find is closed and cleared |
| `H` | Locate HEAD, or show an out-of-range hint |
| `Enter` / `Space` on a row or node | Select that commit |
| Drag a column divider / `←` / `→` | Resize a column; arrow keys work when the divider is focused |
| Double-click a divider | Restore its default width |
dsh-git-graph README · Keyboard controls：Shortcuts apply while focus is inside Git Graph. Normal navigation keys do not intercept typing in inputs or scrolling in a file viewer.

dsh-git-graph README · FAQ：**How do I view commits and file diffs in DeepSeek Harness Web?**

[Install the plugin](#install-or-update) for DSH 0.2.1-rc.5, then open **dsh-git-graph** from the native right sidebar. See [Usage](#usage) for two-commit comparisons and full historical source.

**Why does DSH report `cannot resolve profile bundle "dsh-git-graph"`?**

dsh-git-graph README · FAQ：A previous local-directory installation may still link to a folder that was moved or deleted. Reinstall the Release package in the same profile; removing it first also lets DSH register the bundle again if the old installation was no longer enabled:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-git-graph
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/WhitePlusMS/dsh-git-graph/releases/download/v0.6.1/dsh-git-graph-0.6.1.tgz
```

dsh-git-graph README · FAQ：Restart that DSH Web instance afterward. Running `dsh plugin --profile web install` alone reuses the saved package source and cannot repair a link to a missing folder.

**Is `dsh-git-graph` on npm?**

No. The npm package with this name belongs to a different project by another author. Install this plugin from the Release archive URL shown above; `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-git-graph` (a bare package name) would resolve to that other project.

**Is this the same as other DSH Git plugins?**

dsh-git-graph README · FAQ：No. Plugins such as `kp-z/dsh-dev-git-graph`, `lengmoXXL/dsh-git`, `EasyTZ/dsh-git`, and `LeonZ666/dsh-gitworktree-gui` are independent projects. This one is a read-only Git Graph for the native right sidebar, installed only from this repository's Releases.

**Do I need an API key or a conversation message?**

No. Git Graph reads the current workspace's local Git data directly.

**Can Git Graph commit, merge, push, pull, or fetch?**
dsh-git-graph README · FAQ：No. The plugin is read-only; refreshing the graph does not fetch remote changes or modify the repository.

dsh-git-graph README · Scope：- Initially loads 100 commits, with manual loading up to 500. Search scans up to 2,000 commits and shows a warning when earlier history remains unscanned; Find searches loaded results. Reference-type filters show commits directly carrying the selected kind of label.
- Historical file viewers provide unified diffs and full text up to 1 MiB per file. Binary and oversized files show their status; text is not truncated and presented as complete. Renamed, added, and deleted files use the available version and corresponding path.
- Side-by-side diffs, syntax highlighting, tag signature verification, and stash diffs are not available. Tag/stash entries provide summaries and copying.
